unitTitle: Present Perfect Simple - Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple - Present Perfect Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 7-unit (Profiles) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: Present Perfect Simple shakli va ishlatilishi.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 7-UNIT NAZARIYA (34-bet, PDF 33). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '7', sarlavha: 'Present Perfect Simple - Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple - Present Perfect Continuous'. Och pushti ramka.

'Present Perfect' - 'A) Regular Verb' JADVALI: Affirmative - Long form: I have worked, you have worked, he has worked, she has worked, it has worked, we have worked, you have worked, they have worked; Short form: I've worked, you've worked, he's worked, she's worked, it's worked, we've worked, you've worked, they've worked. Interrogative: Have I worked? Have you worked? Has he worked? Has she worked? Has it worked? Have we worked? Have you worked? Have they worked? Negative - Long form: I have not worked ... they have not worked; Short form: I haven't worked, you haven't worked, he hasn't worked, she hasn't worked, it hasn't worked, we haven't worked, you haven't worked, they haven't worked.
'B) Irregular Verb' JADVALI: xuddi shunday 'bought' bilan: I have bought / I've bought / Have I bought? / I have not bought / I haven't bought ...
'Form': • We form the present perfect simple with the auxiliary verb have/has and the past participle. We form the past participle of regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. 'play - played, work - worked'. We form the past participle of irregular verbs differently. 'buy - bought, see - seen' • We form questions by putting have/has before the subject. 'Has he bought a new car?' • We form negations by putting not between have/has and the past participle. 'He has not/hasn't bought a new car.'
'Use': We use the present perfect simple: • for actions which happened at an unstated time in the past. The exact time is not mentioned because the action is more important. 'Tom has broken his arm.' • for actions which started in the past and are still continuing in the present. 'Kim has been a chef since 1985.' • for actions which have recently finished and their results are visible in the present. '"I have painted the kitchen. Doesn't it look nice?"' • to talk about an experience. 'They have travelled through Europe.'
'Time expressions used with the present perfect simple': for, since, just, already, yet, lately, recently, so far, ever, etc.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '34'.

exercises.instructionEn: Regular verb: I/you/we/they have worked (I've worked), he/she/it has worked (he's worked). Interrogative: Have I worked? Has he worked? Negative: I have not (haven't) worked, he has not (hasn't) worked. Irregular verb: I have bought (I've bought), he has bought (he's bought); Have I bought? Has he bought?; I haven't bought, he hasn't bought. Form: We form the present perfect simple with the auxiliary verb have/has and the past participle. Regular verbs: + -ed (play - played, work - worked). Irregular verbs: differently (buy - bought, see - seen). Questions: have/has before the subject: Has he bought a new car? Negations: not between have/has and the past participle: He has not/hasn't bought a new car.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri fe'l: I/you/we/they have worked (I've worked), he/she/it has worked (he's worked). So'roq: Have I worked? Has he worked? Inkor: I have not (haven't) worked, he has not (hasn't) worked. Noto'g'ri fe'l: I have bought (I've bought), he has bought (he's bought); Have I bought? Has he bought?; I haven't bought, he hasn't bought. Shakl: Present perfect simple have/has yordamchi fe'li + fe'lning 3-shakli (past participle) bilan yasaladi. To'g'ri fe'llar: + -ed (play - played, work - worked). Noto'g'ri fe'llar: boshqacha (buy - bought, see - seen). Savol: have/has egadan oldin: U yangi mashina sotib oldimi? Inkor: have/has va 3-shakl orasiga not: U yangi mashina sotib olmagan.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT = HAVE / HAS +
  FE'L 3-ShAKLI (V3).

  TASDIQ:
    I / you / we / they HAVE worked
    he / she / it HAS worked
    Qisqa: I've, you've, he's,
    she's, it's, we've, they've

  SO'ROQ (have/has oldinga):
    HAVE you worked?
    HAS he bought a new car?

  INKOR (not orasiga):
    I HAVEN'T worked
    He HASN'T bought a new car


V3 (PAST PARTICIPLE):

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: + -ed
    play → played, work → worked
    (V2 bilan bir xil)
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: alohida
    buy → bought (V2 = V3)
    see → SEEN (V2 = saw, V3 = seen)
    ⚠ Kitob oxiridagi jadval - 3-
    ustun!


⚠ 'HE'S' IKKI MA'NODA:

  he's worked = he HAS worked
  he's a doctor = he IS a doctor
  Keyin V3 bo'lsa - HAS.

points.en: I have worked / I've worked — he has worked / he's worked (regular: + -ed)
I have bought / I've bought — he has bought / he's bought (irregular)
Has he bought a new car? (have/has before the subject)
He has not / hasn't bought a new car. (not between have/has and the past participle)

exercises.instructionEn: We use the present perfect simple: for actions which happened at an unstated time in the past (the exact time is not mentioned because the action is more important): Tom has broken his arm; for actions which started in the past and are still continuing in the present: Kim has been a chef since 1985; for actions which have recently finished and their results are visible in the present: 'I have painted the kitchen. Doesn't it look nice?'; to talk about an experience: They have travelled through Europe. Time expressions: for, since, just, already, yet, lately, recently, so far, ever, etc.
exercises.instructionUz: Present perfect simple ishlatiladi: o'tmishda NOMA'LUM VAQTDA bo'lgan harakatlar uchun (aniq vaqt aytilmaydi, chunki harakatning o'zi muhimroq): Tom qo'lini sindirib olgan; o'tmishda boshlanib HOZIR HAM DAVOM ETAYOTGAN harakatlar uchun: Kim 1985-yildan beri oshpaz; YAQINDA TUGAGAN va natijasi hozir ko'rinib turgan harakatlar uchun: 'Men oshxonani bo'yadim. Chiroyli ko'rinmayaptimi?'; TAJRIBA haqida gapirish uchun: Ular Yevropa bo'ylab sayohat qilishgan. Vaqt so'zlari: for, since, just, already, yet, lately, recently, so far, ever va h.k.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT QAChON - 4 HOLAT.

  1) NOMA'LUM VAQT (qachon - muhim
     emas, harakat muhim):
     Tom HAS BROKEN his arm.
     (qachon? - aytilmaydi; hozir
     qo'li singan)

  2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB, HOZIR HAM
     DAVOM ETAYOTGAN:
     Kim HAS BEEN a chef since
     1985. (hozir ham oshpaz)

  3) YAQINDA TUGAGAN, NATIJASI
     KO'RINIB TURIBDI:
     I HAVE PAINTED the kitchen.
     Doesn't it look nice?

  4) TAJRIBA (hayotda bir marta
     bo'lganmi):
     They HAVE TRAVELLED through
     Europe.


VAQT SO'ZLARI (belgilar):

  for (muddat), since (nuqta),
  just (endigina), already
  (allaqachon), yet (hali),
  lately / recently (yaqinda), so
  far (hozirgacha), ever (hech
  qachon - savolda)


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  Present Perfect = '-gan' / '-di'
  (natija hozir bor): 'sindirgan',
  'bo'yadim' (mana, ko'ring).

Kim has been a chef since 1985. (started in the past, still continuing)

patterns.formula: Has / Have + KIM + V3? — KIM + hasn't / haven't + V3
patterns.exampleEn: Has he bought a new car? He hasn't bought a new car.
patterns.exampleUz: U yangi mashina sotib oldimi? U yangi mashina sotib olmagan.

patterns.formula: KIM + has been + ... + since + NUQTA / for + MUDDAT
patterns.exampleEn: Kim has been a chef since 1985.
